digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI (name shared with Swahili)

teaser.en: Its figs grow in heavy bunches straight from the trunk, turning red when they are ready to eat.
teaser.sw: Tini zake hukua kwa vichala vizito moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina, zikigeuka nyekundu zinapokuwa tayari kuliwa.

summary.en: *Mkuyu*, the broom-cluster or Cape fig, is a fig tree of riverbanks and forest edges with large toothed leaves and heavy clusters of figs on its trunk. It gives edible figs, shade and medicine.
summary.sw: *Mkuyu*, mtini unaojulikana kwa Kiingereza kama *broom-cluster fig* au *Cape fig*, ni mti wa kingo za mito na pembezoni mwa misitu wenye majani makubwa yenye meno pembeni na vichala vizito vya tini kwenye shina lake. Hutoa tini zinazoliwa, kivuli na dawa.

about.en: *Mkuyu* is a fig tree with large leaves that have toothed edges, unusual among figs. Its figs grow in heavy, branched clusters on the trunk and larger branches, sometimes near the ground. They turn red when ripe. Like all figs, it bleeds a milky latex when cut.
about.sw: *Mkuyu* ni mtini wenye majani makubwa yenye meno pembeni, jambo lisilo la kawaida miongoni mwa mitini. Tini zake hukua kwa vichala vizito vyenye matawi kwenye shina na matawi makubwa, wakati mwingine karibu na ardhi. Hugeuka nyekundu zinapoiva. Kama mitini yote, hutoa utomvu kama maziwa ukikatwa.

where.en: It grows on riverbanks and at forest edges. Fruiting trees are easy to spot from the red clusters on their trunks, and from the animals that come to feed.
where.sw: Hukua kwenye kingo za mito na pembezoni mwa misitu. Miti yenye matunda ni rahisi kuiona kutokana na vichala vyekundu kwenye mashina yake, na wanyama wanaokuja kula.

uses.en: The figs are eaten. The tree is valued for shade, and, like other figs, it is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Tini zake huliwa. Mti huu unathaminiwa kwa kivuli, na kama mitini mingine, hutumika katika dawa za jadi.

names.en: Pakia gives the Digo name *mkuyu*, which is shared with Swahili. In English it is the broom-cluster fig or Cape fig. The Mgombato dictionary uses the Digo name *mgandi* for the Cape fig, while Pakia gives *mgandi* to the sycamore fig. In Swahili, *mkuyu* is also used for the sycamore fig, so the names cross over between the two trees.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa jina la Kidigo *mkuyu*, ambalo pia linatumika kwa Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *broom-cluster fig* au *Cape fig*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia jina la Kidigo *mgandi* kwa *Cape fig*, ilhali Pakia analipa jina *mgandi* kwa *sycamore fig*. Kwa Kiswahili, *mkuyu* pia hutumika kwa *sycamore fig*, hivyo majina yanavuka kati ya miti hii miwili.

reason.en: The sycamore fig; their names overlap

reason.sw: Msasa, mtini wenye majani kama msasa

reason.en: Also fruits along rivers and forest edges
reason.sw: Pia huzaa matunda kando ya mito na pembezoni mwa misitu
